table.retrieve:
SELECT
	quotationcode = dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode, 
	username=(select username from users where users.usercode=quotationheader.salesmancode),
	date = dbo.quotationheader.date,   
	genericname=(select name from genericitem where genericcode=item.genericcode),
	manufacturer=(select name from manufacturer where manufacturer.manfcode=item.manfcode),
	invdiscperc = dbo.quotationheader.discperc,    
	flatdisc = dbo.quotationheader.flatdisc,    
	misccharges = dbo.quotationheader.misccharges, 
	invsalestax = dbo.quotationheader.salestax,
	invgstperc1 = dbo.quotationheader.invgstperc1,
	remarks   = dbo.quotationheader.remarks,
	custrefno1   = dbo.quotationheader.custrefno,
	dbo.quotationheader.Remarks2,
	dbo.quotationheader.Remarks3,
	dbo.quotationheader.Remarks4,
	dbo.quotationheader.Remarks5,
	dbo.quotationheader.Remarks6,
	dbo.quotationheader.Remarks7,
	dbo.quotationheader.Remarks8,
	dbo.quotationheader.Remarks9,
	quotationheader.ValidateUpTo,
	posted = dbo.quotationheader.posted,	
	looseqty = dbo.quotationdetail.qty,
	itemalias=item.customicode,
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc, 
	packing=case when dbo.item.packcode IS Null then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end,
	itemflatdisc=quotationdetail.itemflatdisc,
	/*price = Round(dbo.item.purprice / CASE dbo.quotationheader.LoosePack WHEN 1 THEN CASE dbo.item.packunits when 0  then 1 else dbo.item.packunits end ELSE 1 END, 2),*/
	price =quotationdetail.saleprice,
	itemdiscperc = dbo.quotationdetail.discperc,    
	packunits = dbo.item.packunits,    
	mrp = Round(dbo.item.retailprice / CASE dbo.quotationheader.LoosePack WHEN 1 THEN CASE dbo.item.packunits when 0  then 1 else dbo.item.packunits end ELSE 1 END, 2),
	sp_rate= Round((dbo.quotationdetail.saleprice - quotationdetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - dbo.quotationdetail.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - dbo.quotationheader.discperc * 0.01), 2),
	salestax  = quotationdetail.salestax,
	itemname = Case When quotationdetail.itemdescription IS Null OR RTrim(LTrim(quotationdetail.itemdescription)) = '' THEN item.name Else quotationdetail.itemdescription END,
	unitsalestax = dbo.quotationdetail.unitsalestax ,    
	gstperc = dbo.quotationdetail.gstperc ,    
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, quotationheader.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, quotationheader.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, quotationheader.date)))), 
	Person = dbo.accounts.name,
	  address = dbo.customer.address1,   
         address2= dbo.customer.address2, 
		customerphone=dbo.customer.phone,  
         city= dbo.customer.city,    
         licenceno= dbo.customer.licenceno,   
		taxregno=customer.salestaxregno,
	totalsalestax = 
		(SELECT invtotalsalestax= 
			Round (
			/*invoice level salestax*/Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( SD.qty * ( SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) )
					* ( 1 - SL.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - SL.flatdisc ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 )
			/*items salestax*/		 + Sum (Round (SD.qty * SD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (SD.qty * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
			, 0 )
		FROM dbo.quotationheader SL, dbo.quotationdetail SD
		WHERE  
			(SL.quotationcode = dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode )   and
			(SL.quotationcode = SD.quotationcode )   
		GROUP BY 
			SL.misccharges,   
			SL.flatdisc,   
			SL.date,   
			SL.quotationcode, 
			SL.invgstperc1, 
			SL.discperc,  
			SL.salestax)
FROM
	dbo.quotationheader, 
	dbo.quotationdetail,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.customer
WHERE  
	dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode = :al_sqcode and
	dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode = dbo.quotationdetail.quotationcode and  
	dbo.quotationdetail.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.quotationheader.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and
	dbo.quotationheader.custcode=dbo.customer.custcode
ORDER BY
	quotationcode,
	quotationdetail.rowid

objects.name: compute_1
objects.expression: sum( (  ( looseqty *  (price - itemflatdisc)) )  *  ( 1-  ( itemdiscperc  *  .01 )  )    for all)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) - flatdisc  +   misccharges    , 0) + totalsalestax
